mail.inviteSubject: Your invitation to the GWS language training app
mail.inviteBody:
Hello {name},

GWS language has invited you to the training app for the German nursing language exam (Fachsprachprüfung Pflege).

Set your password here:
{link}

The link is valid for 24 hours.

Best regards
Your GWS team

{link}

Best regards
Your GWS team

the GWS team has replied to you in the language training app:

your goal for today is {min} minutes. So far you have studied {done} minutes – {left} minutes to go.

Continue here:
{link}

Best regards

mail.deletedSubject: Your data in the GWS language app has been deleted
mail.deletedBody:
Hello {name},

we have deleted all your data from the training app: learning progress, submissions, voice recordings, exam attempts and messages.

Your login account is shared with the visa portal and therefore still exists. If you would like that account deleted as well, simply reply to this email.

Best regards
Your GWS team

exam.title: Mock exam
exam.intro: Test yourself under real conditions: all parts in a row, with time limits and a results report at the end.
exam.rule1: The exam takes about {minutes} minutes in total. Each part has its own time limit.
exam.rule2: The clock keeps running even if you close the page. When time is up, the part is submitted automatically.
exam.rule3: You cannot go back to an earlier part. Audio can only be played a limited number of times, as in the real exam.
exam.rule4: As a guideline you pass with at least {percent} % in both the written and the oral part.
exam.rule5: GWS assesses writing and speaking. Until then your result is provisional.
exam.readyHint: Ready? Find a quiet place and have headphones and a microphone ready.
exam.startError: The exam could not be started. Please try again.
exam.confirmFinishPart: Really submit this part? You cannot go back afterwards.
exam.openQuestions: {count, plural, one {# question is still open.} other {# questions are still open.}}
exam.confirmEndEarly: All remaining parts will count as 0 points.

exam.noAudio: Your browser cannot play the audio. Please use Chrome, Edge or Safari.
exam.recordIntro: Record your answer (max. {max}). You can record again; the last recording is submitted.
exam.recorded: Recording saved – it will be submitted with this part.
exam.micError: No access to the microphone. Please allow access in your browser.

verdict.failed: At least one part is below {percent} %. See below what to practise.

exam.passLine: The line marks the pass mark of {percent} %.

readiness.title: Exam readiness

reasons.idle: Has not studied for more than 14 days.
reasons.manyWeak: At least 3 lessons below 70 % – needs revision.
reasons.partsMissing: At least one exam part (listening, reading, writing, speaking) not practised yet.

readiness.rule: Exam ready = at least 80 % of lessons done, average result at least 75 % and all four exam parts practised.

privacy.requestIntro: You can ask us at any time to delete all your data from the training app: learning progress, submissions, voice recordings, exam attempts and messages. After that you can no longer use the app.

privacy.deleteKeeps: Only the login account remains, because it is shared with the visa portal. The person can no longer access the training app with it.
